breaking_changes: The version scheme changed from M.m.p to YYYY.WW.N format; CMake version extraction moved to a Python-based git state derivation system, MSI installer versions are reformatted as YY.MM.PATCH, and the get-version action now outputs YYYY.WW.N instead of the static CMake VERSION.

checklist.text: Install or build packages on each platform and confirm the new YYYY.WW.N version format appears correctly in version outputs, MSI labels, and container tags (#3539, @superm1).

Start the server, fetch GET /v1/docs to confirm the JSON index includes the running version, verify at least one individual page returns correct markdown, and test the lemonade_docs MCP tool with a standard MCP client (#3347, @anditherobot).

Push a release-v* branch and confirm MSI signing is skipped, a candidate-v* tag is created, artifacts publish correctly, and release notes display the unsigned-installer warning (#3579, @jeremyfowers).

Set default_model_source to modelscope and confirm --modelscope 1 reaches the flm binary in both load-time and explicit pull paths, then verify JSON API responses for registry_source round-trip correctly through parse_remote_registry_source() (#2841, @wariobot09).

Confirm the common-denominator GGUF architecture allowlist is an intentional policy and that the extra HF metadata request does not cause excessive latency or 429 errors on /pull/variants for popular models (#3198, @popey).

evidence.blockers: Nothing blocks the release. Five P1 verifications remain: downstream version format, new API/MCP tool, candidate pipeline, FLM download path, and GGUF architecture filter allowlist.
evidence.breaking_changes: The version scheme change affects all platform consumers: CMake projects using the get-version action will see YYYY.WW.N output, MSI installers will use YY.MM.PATCH labels, and package versions on Fedora/Debian/Ubuntu/Snap/Docker will use the new format. All downstream packaging pipelines have been updated in #3539 but need verification that they render the version correctly end-to-end.
evidence.coverage: Reviewed 38 of 39 commits in the range; 1 commit (8d89896, #3565 re: backends-reference note) has no commit review. All items with unresolved to-dos from the prior review are carried forward with stable wording.
evidence.manual_testing: The release adds a new version scheme touching every platform's packaging surface, a new HTTP endpoint and MCP tool, and new CI publishing behavior for candidates. These require human verification on the target platforms and with real MCP clients before shipping.
evidence.security: Wildcard port and domain matching in origin validation (PR #3470) was flagged for regex compilation in the hot path, but the string-based subdomain matching is functionally secure and the concern is performance-only. The new /v1/docs endpoint enforces path confinement against directory traversal. No security regressions observed.

verdict_reason: Five manual verifications before shipping: the new version scheme on downstream packages, the /v1/docs API and MCP tool, the candidate publishing pipeline, the FLM download path with ModelScope, and the GGUF architecture filter — none are P0 blockers, but none can be skipped.
